mapper.select: SELECT p.project_id AS "projectId", p.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", p.subject, p.status AS "projectStatus", TO_CHAR(p.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startAt", TO_CHAR(p.end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endAt", p.progress FROM projects p JOIN project_members pm ON p.project_id = pm.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL ORDER BY p.project_id
